services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: The main story: a $150 private cooking lesson (90 minutes) at Alex's home with Tomas. A card is saved for the $40 fee, and the $150 is charged when Tomas texts DONE.

services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: The same $150 lesson, paid in full when booking, as some cooks ask. A $150 group class at a host's place is paid in full this way too.

services_shape: class: a seat in a set class time by cooking, age group and level, with a set number of seats, a few trial seats and a waitlist; each learner booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the school, at a home, or by video. A class at a host's place (a school, a company office, a library) books a teacher's time for a group
questions_before_times: who is learning: the adult themselves, or the parent's child (the age sets the class)
which cooking, and the level: never studied, some before, or a fluent speaker who wants a refresher
the goal: travel, school, work, or fun
at the school, by video, or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many learners, their ages, and the place
safety_stop: someone hurt right now: a deep cut, a bad burn or scald, fainting, a child choking, chest pain, trouble breathing
first_steps: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
Placement for a learner who knows some of the cooking
license: none for a cooking school or a cook in most places; where the state's form names a license or registration, the owner adds it as an optional item. Rosie checks no license, certificate, insurance or background check
staff_skills: knife skills, pasta, bread, Thai and baking; menu planning; children's classes only for cooks the owner OKs for children
messages_never: a child's last name, age, allergies, food restrictions or health notes, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
